text: dsh-agent-activity 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话页的 Agent 动态卡片。Host 端把会话事件折叠成 activity 投影，浏览器端在输入框上方显示当前阶段、已完成和正在运行的工具、下一步计划以及回答预览；展开后可查看待办清单和动作详情，也可收起当前轮次。适合想了解 Agent 正在做什么、刚完成什么的用户。

dsh-agent-activity adds a live card to DeepSeek Harness web conversations. A host projection summarizes session events; the browser shows the agent’s phase, tool progress, upcoming tasks, and answer preview above the composer. Expand it for task and action details, or hide the turn.
我想在 DSH 对话进行时看到 Agent 当前在处理什么。
能不能把这轮已经调用过的工具和执行结果整理成一张动态卡片？
Show me the agent’s current phase, recent actions, and what it plans to do next while a conversation is running.
dsh-agent-activity 的功能「会话动态摘要」：持续汇总本轮阶段、工具调用及成功或失败状态，并在对话输入框上方显示。
dsh-agent-activity 的功能「待办与回答预览」：展示待办进度、模型已声明的后续动作和正在生成的回答片段；卡片可展开查看或收起。

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that makes the agent's working process visible **while it is still working** — before the final answer lands.

The card docks right above the composer, in the same place as the todo panel, and answers three questions at a glance:

dsh-agent-activity README · dsh-agent-activity：- **What has it already done?** Every tool call of the current turn, in order, with its target and how long it took (✓ / ✗ / spinner).
- **What is it doing now?** A phase label — *thinking*, *running a tool*, *writing the answer* — plus the current step number.
- **What is it about to do?** The tool calls the model has just announced but not yet run, followed by the next unfinished todo.

dsh-agent-activity README · dsh-agent-activity：While the model streams a reply, the card also shows the leading edge of that reply, so you can tell the difference between "thinking", "stuck" and "writing".

dsh-agent-activity README · Every row says *why*, then what was done：A row used to read `write file · client.js`, which tells you nothing unless you already know the code — and
even `delete dist/*.tgz` only says *where*, not *why*. Each row now leads with the purpose, in this order:

dsh-agent-activity README · Every row says *why*, then what was done：The concrete detail follows as small print: `run tests activity.test.mjs`, `delete dist/*.tgz`,
`search “commandPlan”`, `commit feat: x`. So the big line answers **what this step was for**, the small line
answers **what it touched** — never the raw tool name.

When the same action on the same object repeats (three `git status` in a row), the rows collapse into one with
a `×N` badge instead of padding the list.
section: Every row says *why*, then what was done

text:
dsh-agent-activity README · Read the list, not the mechanics：The card now leads with the same thing the built-in **Tasks** panel above the composer leads with: the
list. Opened, it shows one row per todo — `✓ done`, spinner `in progress`, hollow `not started` — and the
tool calls move down into a secondary *What I ran* section. Collapsed, the single line is the todo being
worked on, followed by `2 done · 1 now · 1 to go`.
section: Read the list, not the mechanics

text:
dsh-agent-activity README · Read the list, not the mechanics：Rows still carry the plain-language label (`edit “收起时是一行”`, `run tests · activity.test.mjs`), so the
two halves answer different questions: the list says **what is left**, the rows say **what that meant**.
section: Read the list, not the mechanics

text:
dsh-agent-activity README · Read the list, not the mechanics：It collapses to a single line and **stays there after the turn ends**, so the card doubles as the
entry point for "what did it just do?" — click it open, read the rows, click × to fold that turn into
a small pill. The pill is not a delete: click it and the card comes back, and a page refresh restores
it too. Reopening a past conversation shows the last turn of that conversation (the projection keeps
exactly one turn of history, which is what the card needs).
section: Read the list, not the mechanics

text: dsh-agent-activity README · Why a plugin and not a skill：A skill can only add instructions to the model's context; it cannot render anything. This is a UI plugin: a Host half that folds the session event log into a small "activity" projection, and a Client half that renders it in the Harness Web UI.
section: Why a plugin and not a skill

text:
dsh-agent-activity README · Install：The package is a DeepSeek Harness bundle. Install it from a directory or from a packed tarball with the Plugin Manager:

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=/path/to/dsh-agent-activity
```

`application: applied` means the Host half is live; the card appears above the composer in the Web UI. Replacing an already-installed version needs a Harness restart to pick up the new browser bundle.

There is nothing to configure. No data leaves the machine.

dsh-agent-activity README · What it renders：The card speaks in plain language instead of tool names: what happened, what is happening
now, and what is queued. It deliberately does **not** echo your message — the transcript right
above already shows it. The collapsed line is one stable row:

```
⠋ 正在做事   正在 改文件 · client.js                     已做 5 件事 · 12秒  ⌃
```

Click it and the panel opens as a floating overlay above the card (Escape, outside click or
a second click closes it) — opening it never changes the page layout:

dsh-agent-activity README · What it renders：```
我做了什么   改文件 3 · 跑测试 2 · 发版 1
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
✓  改文件     …/lib/client.js                                        1.2s
   为了 先确认卡片头部现在渲染的是什么

dsh-agent-activity README · What it renders：Every row carries the reason the agent gave for that step — the sentence it wrote right before the
call, quoted back as 为了 …. When the agent said nothing (or the step is a long scripted chain),
the card falls back to the todo item it is currently working on, so a row is never just
"跑脚本 · x.py" with no purpose.

dsh-agent-activity README · What it renders：That is the whole point: **plain words**, then a recap of what the agent did for the task
(`改文件 3 · 跑测试 2 · 发版 1`), then the rows and what is queued. No API names — `npm test`
reads 跑测试, `"$NODE" --check lib/client.js` reads 检查语法 · client.js, `curl -o x.tgz …`
reads 下载文件 · x.tgz, `git push` reads 提交代码. A file path collapses to its last two
segments, a search shows its quoted term, and a command that cannot be classified shows
执行命令 next to the command itself — never a vague label with no information. Tool names
survive only in the hover tooltip. Wording follows the UI language (Chinese and English),
long rows wrap to two lines, and the answer preview keeps its line breaks.

dsh-agent-activity README · What it renders：If the agent also keeps a todo list, the panel shows it as a checklist under
「为了完成你的要求，我打算」 with ✓ done / ⠋ running / ○ pending — that is the plan in the
agent's own words, so it leads the panel whenever it exists.

dsh-agent-activity README · How it works：- **Host** (`lib/index.js`, `lib/activity.js`) registers the session projection `activity` with a single `apply(state, event)` fold over the durable event log: `turn/start`, `step/start`, `assistant/message`, `tool/call`, `tool/result`, `turn/end`. The fold is pure and synchronous, returns the same state reference for events it does not care about, and keeps a bounded log (32 tool calls) so long turns stay cheap.
- **Wire** (`wire.view`) hands the finished value to the Client. The Client never folds events itself — it reads `useProjection("activity")` and, for the plan row, the built-in `todos` projection.
- Because the projection is registered at boot and has no persisted rows yet, sessions restored from an older checkpoint simply re-fold their log through `init` + `apply`; no migration is needed.

dsh-agent-activity README · How it works：The projection key is `activity`, and its state is plain JSON:

```ts
{
  v: 2,
  turn: number, step: number,
  phase: "idle" | "thinking" | "tool" | "writing" | "done" | "error" | "aborted",

dsh-agent-activity README · Development：```bash
node scripts/check-manifest.mjs   # manifest, export map, patch row, icon, locales
node --test tests/activity.test.mjs
node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/activity.js && node --check lib/index.js
```

`tests/activity.test.mjs` replays synthetic session events through the fold and asserts the item list, plan, phase transitions, error accounting and the projection's wire identity — no browser required.

dsh-agent-activity README · Layout：```
lib/index.js       Host entry: registers the session projection
lib/activity.js    Pure event fold + tool-call summarizer (no dependencies)
lib/client.js      Web UI card, dictionaries, styles
locale/*.json      meta.title / meta.description for the Plugin Manager
